scaling_parameter.name: num_rows
scaling_parameter.description: Number of rows to apply softmax over. In attention: num_rows = batch * num_heads * seq_len

row_size.description: Elements per row. In attention softmax: row_size = seq_len. 128=Llama-7B head_dim, 512=BERT seq, 1024=GPT-2 seq, 2048=Llama seq, 4096=Llama-70B seq

block_size.description: Threads per block for softmax kernel

input_scale.description: Scale factor for random input (controls numerical range): 1=unit, 10=moderate, 100=large
